notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE - JULY25
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a few months since we released [i]PSYCHExFUSE DEMO[/i] and we're really happy with how much you all loved it! [/p][p][/p][p]We thought we'd let you know that development for the second half of Part 1 (dubbed Part 1:2) is very much underway and our radio silence is us just working very hard! (please believe us). We've got lots in store for you; juicier story bits, more dynamic locations, new threats, and loads of visual & gameplay improvements to what is already available to play in [i]PSYCHExFUSE DEMO[/i] - we can't wait to see what you all think! [/p][p][/p][h3]An official release date announcement will come soon, most likely around [b]Steam Next Fest: October 2025. [/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Until then, use this doodle from our concept artist to tide you over.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077933/3775eb7f0a1a5562c45c9b47d092bcd7e3d70395.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Don't forget to wishlist! [/h3][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p][/p][p][b]MIZAEL[/b][/p][p]SWD & Team MoF Club[/p][p][url="https://sewingwithdaydreams.com/"]https://sewingwithdaydreams.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://discord.gg/RWpEEpcZXH"]PSYCHExFUSE LINK TERMINAL[/url] (Discord)[/h3]
